subject: Remove continue in OnFlushDBEnded, to async free when recreate fails (#1204)
reason: The diff only removes a `continue` inside OnFlushDBEnded's recreate-failure branch, so a schema whose coordinator-mode recreation fails during FLUSHDB is freed on the utility thread instead of inline on the main thread. That branch is unreachable from any input: recreating a just-removed schema from its own proto can only fail on conditions that cannot arise (name already exists — just erased; vector-type conflict — validated against the same set it already coexisted with; JSON module missing — a data-type-exporting module cannot be unloaded, and the index could not exist without it; keyspace
